name: Enhanced Brewing Stand
description:
After the Altar creation is complete, a player has to place up to 8 matching solid blocks (of any kind) near the altar. These blocks require 1 block of air above them and no solid blocks touching them on the sides and diagonally. These blocks are the pedestals. The Dragon Essence Altar will project purple particles to all the pedestals connected to it.

Dropping an item onto the pedestal will place it there. After the item has been placed on top of the pedestal, the altar will start "infusing" the item using Dragon Essence stored in the altar itself. Adding more essence to the altar is done by right-clicking.

Infusing makes items repair themselves (this does not work for items that require Energy), increases the level of existing enchantments (up to 4 enchantments per item) and can even add new enchantments.

There are two items in this mod that can be obtained only by Dragon Essence infusion:

Enhanced Brewing Stand - by infusing a vanilla Brewing Stand, requires 20 pieces of Dragon Essence.

Temple Caller - by infusing a vanilla Eye of Ender, requires 50 pieces of Dragon Essence. [warn]It's disabled though, so don't bother.[/warn]
